title: Vibe-Hackers: Script kiddies, stronger?
description: Hello, i am sharing a concern/opinion that i’ve been contemplating for the past couple of years. Today, we see how vibe coders with plain-english are building basic websites/webapps/mobile apps etc… you name it. Most of it is being used for good. Setting aside the quality, slop and everything else, this is not our concern. For me, the AI/agentic systems surge, directly empowered another group of people: Hackers, regardless of their nature (black hat, white hat etc…). Similar to software engineers, hackers required an immensive amount of theoretical knowledge, practical expertise and years of experience in order to be market ready (whether for an actual job or not). Script-kiddies as we know them, weren’t that meticulous in their craft , they understood some basics and executed pre-defined scripts. They didnt know how to change them, alter them or even create some their own. But today, in our new agentic-era, I believe English is the only requirement alongside a target.
